thread:
maria_support: Heads up — account acct-42 says their free-trial credits dropped from 10k to ~1.3k overnight. They only run our nightly embeddings job. Can we triage?

devon_infra: Do we have the job id or a sample payload? night-worker usually uses batched /v1/embeddings.

maria_support: Provided by customer: jobId=ny-embed-20260316-7, runs @ 02:00 UTC. They attached a screenshot of the billing ledger showing token burn spike between 02:03–02:12.

devon_infra: Pulling logs now. One sec.

opsbot: Deployment "nightly-ingest" finished at 02:01 UTC on 2026-03-16 (sha: b4f1c2).

devon_infra: Looking at our ingestion logs for ny-embed-20260316-7 -> I see a flurry of retries to the embeddings endpoint with exponential backoff. The worker retried the entire batch 3x due to transient Postgres timeout during callback ack. Each retry re-sent the whole batch (no idempotency key). Logs snippet:```
2026-03-16T02:02:10Z worker: send batch 1 -> /v1/embeddings 200 (tokens: 1200)
2026-03-16T02:03:05Z db: callback write timeout -> error
2026-03-16T02:03:06Z worker: retry batch 1 -> /v1/embeddings 200 (tokens: 1200)
2026-03-16T02:04:30Z worker: retry batch 1 -> /v1/embeddings 200 (tokens: 1200)
```

maria_support: So each of those 3 successful responses counted against their credits? Customer says yes.

sophie_billing: If the embeddings endpoint returned 200 each time, usage will be billed. We can consider a one-off credit adjustment for the trial if there's clear evidence of duplicate sends caused by our SDK/worker. Need payload, timestamps, and billing ledger excerpt.

devon_infra: Root cause appears to be missing idempotency header on the internal worker, and the worker retries the full batch on any callback failure. Newer pipelines use idempotency-token but this legacy job doesn't.

liam_infra: Also noticed a race with callback ack: the callback handler was under a DB migration lock between 02:03–02:05 causing timeouts. So transient DB lock + no idempotency = duplicate consumption.

maria_support: Repro steps from infra: 1) enqueue a batch multi-doc embedding; 2) simulate callback DB timeout; 3) worker retries full batch without idempotency. I can paste a curl to simulate curl -X POST /internal/ingest/trigger -d '{"jobId":"ny-embed-TEST"}' and then block callback writes.

devon_infra: Quick mitigation: add idempotency-key header to worker and perform dedupe server-side for duplicate request signatures. Also add a short-circuit in worker so if DB ack fails it marks job state as "pending-verify" instead of immediate retrying full batch. I'll open a PR.

liam_infra: I'll remove the migration lock window and schedule it later in the maintenance window; that should reduce callback timeouts.

sophie_billing: For the customer resolution: Please collect the following and I can propose a trial credit refund equal to the duplicated usage up to their trial cap: 1) jobId (ny-embed-20260316-7) 2) request IDs for the three embedding calls (from logs) 3) billing ledger snapshot 02:00-02:15 UTC.

maria_support: Got it. I asked the customer for the ledger screenshot and gave them the short explanation + ETA: 24–48h for billing review. They replied "thanks, please don't charge our card if we go over trial".

devon_infra: PR opened: github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/482 -> adds Idempotency: X-Idempotency-Key: <jobId>-<batchIdx> and changes retry strategy. Test plan in PR description.

opsbot: Created incident-3392 (priority: P3) to track remediation and billing follow-up.

liam_infra: Small note — we should also instrument server-side detection of repeated embedding requests (same jobId and batch hash) and emit metric embed_dup_detected. I'll add a dashboard panel.

sophie_billing: Once we get the three request IDs and ledger, I'll process a manual trial-credit restoration and follow up with the customer thread.

maria_support: Customer provided the ledger and request IDs. Uploading to the ticket. Please confirm when refund is applied so I can close the loop. :heart:

devon_infra: Rolling the fix to staging now. If tests pass we'll ship to prod in the next deploy (non-urgent).

sophie_billing: Refund queued — will take up to 24h to reflect in trial balance. I'll post the transaction id here when done.

maria_support: Thanks team — summarizing in the support ticket and leaving remediation steps. Closing Slack thread but will reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
